title: 3574. Maximize Subarray GCD Score

examples.explanation: Double nums[0] to 4 using one operation. The modified array becomes [4, 4]. The GCD of the subarray [4, 4] is 4, and the length is 2. Thus, the maximum possible score is 2 × 4 = 8.
Double nums[2] to 14 using one operation. The modified array becomes [3, 5, 14]. The GCD of the subarray [14] is 14, and the length is 1. Thus, the maximum possible score is 1 × 14 = 14.
The subarray [5, 5, 5] has a GCD of 5, and its length is 3. Since doubling any element doesn't improve the score, the maximum score is 3 × 5 = 15.
